title: Sin complicaciones
style: Euro pop, single female mezzo with a Sardinian Italian accent and careful pronunciation, clear multilingual phrasing with a Campidanese chant intro, stereo-widened polished mix, festive 98 BPM mid-tempo backbeat, palm-muted electric guitar, bright keyboard stabs, drum kit and hand-percussion breaks, family-dinner warmth and road-trip lift.
lyrics:
[Intro – Campidanese]
Nadali non perdu in sa villa de Carbonia,
iaia, su truncu, babbu e mamma in cumpanìa,
cuxinus, ziu Paulu, tottus a sa mesa,
fintzas is fradis mius, ca sa festa est accesa.
Sa fiama est sa fiama.

[Verse 1 – English]
And then the Big Apple, the winter air,
Gabi and Thomas, dinner waiting there,
after a long Christmas Day of planes and delay,
and a night to keep ourselves warm till day.

[Pre-Chorus – Italian]
Pochi giorni a Manhattan nel gelo,
poi l’avventura sotto un altro cielo:
la Colombia tropicale, tutta sole e calore,
¡y que empiece el show, mi amor!

[Chorus – Spanish]
Sin complicaciones,
una estancia sin complicaciones,
ecléctico menú de Noche Vieja,
piscina y sol tímido, sin queja,
caluroso enero sin complicaciones.

[Verse 2 – English]
They put me with Thomas’ sister, you see,
like wrong optics, a scandal, a bad PR spree,
if I stayed with Thomas and Gabi, so I
ended up with the kids and Lucía, oh my,
like I was one more of Thomas’ crew,
the kids, Lucía, and me, what could I do?

[Pre-Chorus – Italian]
Non mi lamento, Lucía è così cara,
solo che la scena mi sembrava rara,
un po’ divertente, no te lo voy a negar,
ma non c’è niente da cambiar.

[Chorus – Spanish]
Sin complicaciones,
una estancia sin complicaciones,
ecléctico menú de Noche Vieja,
piscina y sol tímido, sin queja,
caluroso enero sin complicaciones.

[Bridge – English]
And it was time to come back,
road to Bogotá, kids in the back,
Lucía still beside me, then a flight,
Thomas and Gabi, New York in the light,
a warm night to make up for the lack.

[Breakdown – Catalan]
I benvinguda a Barcelona,
ara en Thomas és per a mi, i la nit és bona,
abans de tornar a la rutina,
i la tesi que em domina.

[Final Chorus – Spanish]
Sin complicaciones,
una estancia sin complicaciones,
caluroso enero en la casa de recreo
de los padres de Thomas en Melgar, qué paseo,
y de nuevo al invierno europeo,
también sin complicaciones.
